include: <script type="module">import { THREE, stage, material, applyLook, loadModel, playLoop } from "/public/components/stage.js";</script>

rules.loop: only between sa:enter and sa:leave; one still frame at load
rules.builds: window.saNext() / window.saPrev() return true while the slide handles the step
rules.loadedSlides: presenter keeps ±2 slides loaded (WebGL context limit)

looks.pbr: Ultra HDR environment (studio | exterior), neutral tone mapping

rules.resolution: stage() renders at saPixelRatio() (max 2 on phones) and redraws on sa:resize
rules.draw: render(camera) from stage(): ambient occlusion in pbr; renderer.render() only for hand-drawn viewports
rules.softShadow: softShadow(floor PlaneGeometry, camera) once the scene is complete (pbr)
rules.physical: MeshPhysicalMaterial in pbr (glass, KHR_materials_*); GLB physical materials are kept by applyLook(model, 'pbr')
rules.glass: transmission refracts only opaque scene objects: backdrop(scene, camera, paint) from /public/components/backdrop.js, stage ao: false, clear: null
